citation: Zelniker TA, Wiviott SD, Raz I, et al. SGLT2 inhibitors for primary and secondary prevention of cardiovascular and renal outcomes in type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis of cardiovascular outcome trials. Lancet. 2019;393(10166):31-39.
conclusion: Pooled SGLT2 inhibitor outcome trials show a moderate MACE reduction confined to patients with established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, and reductions in heart failure hospitalization and renal progression regardless of it.
